claim_steps: Confirm fit: AI startup, application reviewed by NVIDIA after submission.
Apply at nvidia.com/en-us/startups with business and product details; no fees, deadlines, or cohorts.
If accepted, access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, training, SDKs, preferred hardware pricing, and Capital Connect investor exposure.

social_proof.author: Ksenia Moskalenko
social_proof.text: OPPORTUNITY: @nvidia will give your AI startup free training, cloud credits, and VC intros. No VC funding required, no equity, no deadline. This is NVIDIA Inception program. Who qualifies: at least one developer, a working website, officially incorporated, under 10 years old.
Inception is a free program that guides AI startups through the NVIDIA platform and ecosystem. Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners. No application fees, deadlines, or cohorts.
social_proof.title: Inception Program for Startups | NVIDIA

summary: NVIDIA Inception is a free, rolling startup program (verified Sep 13, 2026): free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, free technical courses and workshops, latest SDKs and model libraries, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware/software, investor exposure via Capital Connect, and go-to-market support. No application fees, deadlines, or cohorts; applications are reviewed by NVIDIA. Distinct from the NVIDIA NIM free trial and Inception Labs listings.
